# Spec

Use [spec-driven-development](../skills/spec-driven-development/SKILL.md).

Start by surfacing assumptions, ask clarifying questions until the goal is concrete, and produce a validated spec with objective, commands, structure, style, testing strategy, boundaries, success criteria, and open questions.
